chunks: Who feared Ar-Rahman in secret, and came with a penitent heart:

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنَ: The Merciful (one of the divine names)

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of a believer who fears God in secret and repents?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the virtue of *khushu'* (humble reverence) that persists even in the absence of witnesses, linking it to the concept of *tawbah* (repentance) as an active, continuous return to the Divine. It reflects the inner purification (*tazkiyah*) required for the believer to stand before God on the Day of Judgment with a heart free from hypocrisy.
